body_md:
The UK is historically a Christian country, but people of many faiths live here, and everyone is free to choose their religion or none.

The **Church of England** is the official church in England; the **monarch** is its head and the Archbishop of Canterbury its spiritual leader. The **Church of Scotland** is Presbyterian.

Each country has a patron saint: St David (Wales, 1 March), St Patrick (Northern Ireland, 17 March), St George (England, 23 April) and St Andrew (Scotland, 30 November).
